pull.title: docs: bring every user-facing surface up to 6.45.3 (6.45.4)
pull.body:
Five releases shipped since the last documentation pass (6.41.0 bounded shutdown, 6.41.1 config-dir fix-ups, 6.42.0 `--print-status`, 6.42.1 hermetic tests, 6.43.0 Anthropic OAuth, and the 6.41.3 → 6.45.3 desktop arc). Every user-facing surface was audited against the source rather than against the changelog.

The Markdown had mostly kept up. The **dashboard's own Guide had not**, and four statements across the set were false.

## Audit

| # | Surface | What was wrong / missing | Sev | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `README.md` | "that is **why there is no macOS `.dmg`**" — one has shipped on every release since 6.45.3 | H | fixed |
| 2 | `docs/USAGE.md` | same false claim | H | fixed |
| 3 | Guide → *Use Claude models* | "an Agent SDK script pointed at your proxy is refused" — false since 6.36.0; `entrypoint.py` admits `cli`, `cli-bg`, `sdk-cli`, `sdk-py`, `sdk-ts` | H | fixed |
| 4 | Docs page card (`api/docs_content.py`) | summarised ANTHROPIC-SUBSCRIPTION.md as "why subscription OAuth **is not offered**", four releases after it was | H | fixed |
| 5 | `docs/ANTHROPIC-SUBSCRIPTION.md` | store path given as `~/.fcc/anthropic_oauth.json` (×3) | H | fixed |
| 6 | `ARCHITECTURE.md` | 25 stale `~/.fcc` paths, `FCC_ENV_FILE` named as the canonical dotenv override, "the FCC uv tool"; it ships in the wheel and renders on the Docs page | H | fixed |
| 7 | README + USAGE | Codex catalogue written `~/.fcc/codex-model-catalog.json` (`[model_providers.fcc]` beside it **is** correct — left alone) | M | fixed |
| 8 | Guide | `SERVER_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS` appeared **nowhere** in it | H | fixed |
| 9 | Guide → *Update the server* | nothing about the deferred helper waiting the budget then killing by exact PID (it used to poll for an hour and give up) | H | fixed |
| 10 | Guide → *Troubleshooting* | no entry for the Update button appearing to do nothing, a legacy `~/.fcc`, or Gatekeeper | M | fixed |
| 11 | Guide → *Desktop & RTK* | no `MCC_DESKTOP_SHELL_DIR`, no `MCC_DESKTOP_SKIP_AUTOSTART`, no `.tar.gz`, no start-or-attach, no "one launch, one window", no uninstaller split | M | fixed |
| 12 | Guide → *Desktop & RTK* | "No tray on WSL or headless Linux" — still true, no longer the whole truth | M | fixed |
| 13 | Guide → *Use Claude models* | none of 6.43.0: `~/.claude` fallback, dead store renamed aside, 429/5xx ≠ re-auth, Refresh now / Disconnect, no restart, paste code *or callback URL*; and no explanation of "Caution" | H | fixed |
| 14 | Get Started | the server-vs-desktop choice was on README, USAGE and in the Guide walkthrough, but not on the page a first-run user lands on | M | fixed |
| 15 | `cli/entrypoints.py` (`mcc-help`) | the last surface calling the provider "unsupported by Anthropic" | M | fixed |
| 16 | `anthropic_oauth/cli.py` | post-sign-in message said "only the Claude Code CLI", omitting the Agent SDK its own `--help` names | M | fixed |
| 17 | `anthropic_oauth/credentials.py` | module docstring named `~/.fcc` | L | fixed |
| 18 | `docs/adr/0003-desktop-shell.md` | records "the reason there is no `.dmg`"; Q7 was revised the same day | M | revision note appended, record left standing |
| 19 | `tests/contracts/test_docs_reference_drift.py` | `_MUST_BE_DOCUMENTED` guarded 4 names; 9 more had shipped unguarded | H | **fixed — this is the mechanism** |
| 20 | `tests/api/admin_jsdom_harness.mjs` | shutdown field fixture still `300` / `0 to 3600`; shipped is `20` / `1 to 600` | M | fixed |
| 21 | `README.md` provider table | did not carry the `Caution` the dashboard label shows | L | fixed |

`tests/contracts/test_docs_ui_labels.py` asserted the literal `cc_entrypoint=cli`, which is what let row 3 stand. It now asserts the marker plus the whole admitted set.

## Verified correct, left alone

The Limits & Resilience field help for the shutdown budget (already says the bound, the 503, the stream cut, the clamp and "if you set 300, consider 20"); USAGE §13 *Stopping and restarting*; `.env.example` for both the shutdown budget and `SERVER_LOG_RETAIN_FILES`; the `mcc-migrate` walkthrough in both documents (stop the server **and the tray**, no `--force`, `RESTORE.txt`, `~/.fcc-old`); the "there is deliberately no migrate button" prose and the read-only `GET /admin/api/config-dir` behind it; `tests/README.md` + its link from CONTRIBUTING; the winget paragraph, which correctly says the manifest is prepared and **not** submitted. 6.41.2 changed no documented timing.

## Not reproduced

An `except A, B:` sweep across 22 modules was reported as Python-2 syntax. It is **PEP 758**, valid on `requires-python = ">=3.14.0"` and called out in CONTRIBUTING. Not touched.

## Screenshots

No Guide image renders the Providers page, so the `(OAuth, Caution)` label change makes none of them stale; `admin-limits.png` still matches, since the shutdown field lives on the *Deadlines* card already in the shot and no card moved. **Judged not worth retaking** — it would change pixels without changing a fact any reader gets wrong.

## Surface → what changed

| Surface | Change |
| --- | --- |
| `README.md` | `.dmg` paragraph corrected; OAuth section gains sign-in/Refresh/Disconnect, the viability fallback, transient-vs-definitive refresh, and what "Caution" means; provider table + heading match the shipped label; Codex catalogue paths |
| `docs/USAGE.md` | `.dmg` paragraph corrected; Codex catalogue paths |
| `docs/ANTHROPIC-SUBSCRIPTION.md` | store path is the resolved config dir, with the legacy case named |
| `ARCHITECTURE.md` | config directory described as resolved (`MCC_CONFIG_DIR` → `~/.mcc` → legacy `~/.fcc` → fresh), `MCC_ENV_FILE`, the uninstallers' real scope |
| `docs/adr/0003-desktop-shell.md` | Q7 revision note |
| `admin_static/index.html` | Get Started intro; Claude models warning rewritten; Desktop & RTK; Limits gains *How long a stop may take*; Update the server; Troubleshooting ×3 |
| `api/docs_content.py`, `cli/entrypoints.py`, `anthropic_oauth/cli.py`, `anthropic_oauth/credentials.py` | four stale strings |
| `tests/` | drift contract extended 4 → 13 guarded names; two fixtures unstaled |

No behaviour changes. 9,715 tests pass (9,496 + 219 jsdom), ruff and ty clean.

commit.message:
docs: bring every user-facing surface up to 6.45.3 (6.45.4)

Five releases shipped since the last documentation pass and the docs were
audited against the code rather than against the changelog. Most of the
Markdown had kept up; the dashboard's own Guide had not, and four statements
across the set were false.

False, and fixed:

* README and USAGE both explained "why there is no macOS .dmg". There has been
  one on every release since 6.45.3.
* The Guide told the reader an Agent SDK script pointed at the proxy is
  refused. The entrypoint gate has admitted sdk-cli, sdk-py and sdk-ts since
  6.36.0. `tests/contracts/test_docs_ui_labels.py` was pinning the wrong half
  of that sentence in place, asserting `cc_entrypoint=cli`; it now asserts the
  marker and the admitted set.
* The Docs page card for ANTHROPIC-SUBSCRIPTION.md still summarised it as "why
  subscription OAuth is not offered", four releases after it was offered.
* ARCHITECTURE.md still described `~/.fcc` as the config directory and
  `FCC_ENV_FILE` as the dotenv override. It ships in the wheel and renders on
  the Docs page, so those were 25 wrong paths in front of every reader.

Missing, and added -- all in the Guide, which is where the house rules send a
reader first:

* `SERVER_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS` appeared nowhere in it. It is the 6.41.0
  headline, the reason Update now used to appear to do nothing, and the number
  anyone carrying 300 across from an older install should now lower.
* Update the server now says what the deferred helper does at the bound: waits
  the budget rather than an hour, then terminates by exact process id.
* Desktop & RTK gains the three installers and the tarball, the Gatekeeper
  line for the unsigned .dmg, `MCC_DESKTOP_SHELL_DIR`,
  `MCC_DESKTOP_SKIP_AUTOSTART`, the split between the app's uninstaller and
  the server's, that `mcc-desktop` starts the server or attaches to one, and
  that it no longer leaves a browser tab behind. Its closing line said "no tray
  on WSL or headless Linux", which is still true and had stopped being the
  whole truth: a Linux desktop session has one now.
* Use Claude models gains all of 6.43.0 -- the fallback to ~/.claude when MCC's
  own store is dead, the dead store renamed aside rather than deleted, 429/5xx
  not meaning "sign in again", Refresh now and Disconnect, no restart after an
  import, and pasting the code or the whole callback URL -- and says what
  "Caution" on the provider label actually means.
* Troubleshooting gains the three failures these releases exist to answer: the
  Update button appearing to do nothing, a legacy ~/.fcc, and Gatekeeper
  refusing the app.
* Get Started opens by naming the choice the reader has already made: the
  server with its web dashboard, or the desktop app that installs and starts
  the server for it.

And the mechanism, so this stops recurring: `_MUST_BE_DOCUMENTED` in the
docs-drift contract guarded four names. It now guards thirteen -- the four it
had plus SERVER_GRACEFUL_SHUTDOWN_SECONDS, DESKTOP_SHELL, MCC_DESKTOP_SHELL_DIR,
MCC_DESKTOP_SKIP_AUTOSTART, --print-status and the four installer asset names.
The rule for adding one is on the constant: if a release gives a user a new
thing to type, it goes there.

`tests/api/admin_jsdom_harness.mjs` still declared the shutdown field as
default 300, range 0 to 3600. A stale fixture is how a stale default survives a
green run.

Left alone deliberately, having been checked: the Limits & Resilience field
help for the shutdown budget (already complete), USAGE section 13, .env.example,
the mcc-migrate walkthrough in both documents, tests/README.md's hermeticity
contract, and the winget paragraph. ADR 0003's decision Q7 is a record, so the
reversal is appended to it rather than written over it.

No behaviour changes. 9715 tests pass.
